import Reversal.Spec
import Reversal.Lemmas
namespace Reversal

instance instDecidableValidPost (s : State) (e : Entry) : Decidable (ValidPost s e) := by
  unfold ValidPost; infer_instance

/-- Add `amt` to account `a`. -/
def adjust (bal : AccountId → Int) (a : AccountId) (amt : Int) : AccountId → Int :=
  fun b => if b = a then bal b + amt else bal b

/-- Post every line, first to last. -/
def postLines : List Line → (AccountId → Int) → (AccountId → Int)
  | [], bal => bal
  | l :: ls, bal => postLines ls (adjust bal l.1 l.2)

/-- Apply lines with negated amounts (used for reversal). -/
def reverseLines : List Line → (AccountId → Int) → (AccountId → Int)
  | [], bal => bal
  | l :: ls, bal => reverseLines ls (adjust bal l.1 (-l.2))

def step : Impl := fun s c =>
  match c with
  | .post e =>
    if ValidPost s e then
      (.ok, { s with balance := postLines e.lines s.balance, journal := s.journal ++ [e] })
    else (.rejected, s)
  | .reverse i =>
    match findEntry s.journal i with
    | some e =>
      if i ∈ s.reversed then (.rejected, s)
      else (.ok, { s with balance := reverseLines e.lines s.balance,
                          reversed := i :: s.reversed })
    | none => (.rejected, s)

theorem req_post_succeeds    : PostSucceeds step := sorry
theorem req_reverse_succeeds : ReverseSucceeds step := sorry
theorem req_invalid_noop     : InvalidNoop step := sorry
theorem req_post_effects     : PostEffects step := sorry
theorem req_reverse_effects  : ReverseEffects step := sorry
theorem req_reverse_once     : ReverseOnce step := sorry
theorem req_roundtrip        : RoundTrip step := sorry
theorem req_trial_balance    : TrialBalance step := sorry
theorem req_well_formed      : StaysWellFormed step := sorry
theorem req_consistent       : StaysConsistent step := sorry

end Reversal

theorem req_invalid_noop : InvalidNoop step := by
  intro s c h
  cases c with
  | post e =>
    simp [step, Valid] at h ⊢
    -- ¬ValidPost s e → step = rejected
    have hdec : (if ValidPost s e then (.ok, { s with balance := postLines e.lines s.balance, journal := s.journal ++ [e] }) else (.rejected, s)) = (.rejected, s) := by
      by_cases hv : ValidPost s e
      · exfalso; exact h hv
      · simp [hv]
    exact hdec
  | reverse i =>
    simp [step, Valid] at h ⊢
    by_cases hfind : findEntry s.journal i = none
    · simp [hfind]
    · obtain ⟨e, he⟩ := Option.ne_none_iff_exists.mp hfind
      simp [he]
      -- we have e found
      by_cases hrev : i ∈ s.reversed

import Reversal.Spec
import Reversal.Lemmas
namespace Reversal

instance instDecidableValidPost (s : State) (e : Entry) : Decidable (ValidPost s e) := by
  unfold ValidPost; infer_instance

/-- Add `amt` to account `a`. -/
def adjust (bal : AccountId → Int) (a : AccountId) (amt : Int) : AccountId → Int :=
  fun b => if b = a then bal b + amt else bal b

/-- Post every line, first to last. -/
def postLines : List Line → (AccountId → Int) → (AccountId → Int)
  | [], bal => bal
  | l :: ls, bal => postLines ls (adjust bal l.1 l.2)

/-- Apply lines with negated amounts (used for reversal). -/
def reverseLines : List Line → (AccountId → Int) → (AccountId → Int)
  | [], bal => bal
  | l :: ls, bal => reverseLines ls (adjust bal l.1 (-l.2))

def step : Impl := fun s c =>
  match c with
  | .post e =>
    if ValidPost s e then
      (.ok, { s with balance := postLines e.lines s.balance, journal := s.journal ++ [e] })
    else (.rejected, s)
  | .reverse i =>
    match findEntry s.journal i with
    | some e =>
      if i ∈ s.reversed then (.rejected, s)
      else (.ok, { s with balance := reverseLines e.lines s.balance,
                          reversed := i :: s.reversed })
    | none => (.rejected, s)

theorem req_post_succeeds : PostSucceeds step := by
  unfold PostSucceeds
  intro s e h
  simp [step, h]

theorem req_reverse_succeeds : ReverseSucceeds step := sorry

theorem req_invalid_noop     : InvalidNoop step := sorry

theorem req_post_effects     : PostEffects step := sorry

theorem req_reverse_effects  : ReverseEffects step := sorry

theorem req_reverse_once     : ReverseOnce step := sorry

theorem req_roundtrip        : RoundTrip step := sorry

theorem req_trial_balance    : TrialBalance step := sorry

theorem req_well_formed      : StaysWellFormed step := sorry

theorem req_consistent       : StaysConsistent step := sorry

end Reversal

theorem postLines_balance (bal : AccountId → Int) (ls : List Line) (a : AccountId) :
  postLines ls bal a = bal a + netOf ls a := by
  induction ls generalizing bal with
  | nil => simp [postLines, netOf]
  | cons l ls ih =>
    simp [postLines]
    -- goal: postLines ls (adjust bal l.1 l.2) a = bal a + netOf (l :: ls) a
    have hnet : netOf (l :: ls) a = (if l.1 = a then l.2 else 0) + netOf ls a := by
      simp [netOf, sumOver_cons]
    rw [hnet]
    have ih' := ih (adjust bal l.1 l.2)
    -- need to relate adjust...
    -- compute postLines ls (adjust bal l.1 l.2) a
    rw [ih']
    -- now need (adjust bal l.1 l.2) a + netOf ls a = bal a + (if l.1 = a then l.2 else 0) + netOf ls a
    simp [adjust]
    split_ifs with h
    · simp [h]
    · simp [h]

theorem reverseLines_balance (bal : AccountId → Int) (ls : List Line) (a : AccountId) :
  reverseLines ls bal a = bal a - netOf ls a := by
  induction ls generalizing bal with
  | nil => simp [reverseLines, netOf]
  | cons l ls ih =>
    simp [reverseLines]
    have hnet : netOf (l :: ls) a = (if l.1 = a then l.2 else 0) + netOf ls a := by
      simp [netOf, sumOver_cons]
    rw [hnet]
    have ih' := ih (adjust bal l.1 (-l.2))
    rw [ih']
    simp [adjust]
    split_ifs with h
    · simp [h]; ring
    · simp [h]

theorem req_roundtrip : RoundTrip step := by
  intro s e hpost
  unfold RoundTrip
  constructor
  · -- show reversal succeeds
    simp [step] at hpost
    -- hpost means ValidPost s e is true
    have hvalid : ValidPost s e := by
      -- from if positive
      have : (if ValidPost s e then .ok else .rejected) = .ok := by
        simp [step] at hpost; assumption
      simp at this; exact this
    -- extract properties
    have hid_not_journal : e.id ∉ ids s.journal := hvalid.2.2.2.2
    have hid_not_rev : e.id ∉ s.reversed := hvalid.2.2.2.3
    -- state after post
    have hstate : (step s (.post e)).2 = { s with balance := postLines e.lines s.balance, journal := s.journal ++ [e] } := by
      simp [step, hvalid]
    -- show ValidReverse
    have hfind : findEntry (s.journal ++ [e]) e.id = some e := by
      unfold findEntry
      -- need to use that id not in earlier journal
      -- we can prove by induction on journal, but we know e.id ∉ ids s.journal
      sorry
    -- need to show reversal succeeds
    sorry
  · sorry

instance instDecidableValidPost (s : State) (e : Entry) : Decidable (ValidPost s e) := by

/-- Add `amt` to account `a`. -/

  fun b => if b = a then bal b + amt else bal b

/-- Post every line, first to last. -/
def postLines : List Line → (AccountId → Int) → (AccountId → Int)
  | [], bal => bal

  | [], bal => bal

  | .reverse i =>

    | some e =>

import Reversal.Spec
import Reversal.Lemmas
namespace Reversal

instance instDecidableValidPost (s : State) (e : Entry) : Decidable (ValidPost s e) := by
  unfold ValidPost; infer_instance

/-- Add `amt` to account `a`. -/
def adjust (bal : AccountId → Int) (a : AccountId) (amt : Int) : AccountId → Int :=
  fun b => if b = a then bal b + amt else bal b

/-- Post every line, first to last. -/
def postLines : List Line → (AccountId → Int) → (AccountId → Int)
  | [], bal => bal
  | l :: ls, bal => postLines ls (adjust bal l.1 l.2)

/-- Apply lines with negated amounts (used for reversal). -/
def reverseLines : List Line → (AccountId → Int) → (AccountId → Int)
  | [], bal => bal
  | l :: ls, bal => reverseLines ls (adjust bal l.1 (-l.2))

def step : Impl := fun s c =>
  match c with
  | .post e =>
    if ValidPost s e then
      (.ok, { s with balance := postLines e.lines s.balance, journal := s.journal ++ [e] })
    else (.rejected, s)
  | .reverse i =>
    match findEntry s.journal i with
    | some e =>
      if i ∈ s.reversed then (.rejected, s)
      else (.ok, { s with balance := reverseLines e.lines s.balance,
                          reversed := i :: s.reversed })
    | none => (.rejected, s)

theorem test_sum : (0 : Int) + 0 = 0 := rfl

theorem req_post_succeeds : PostSucceeds step := by
  unfold PostSucceeds
  intro s e h
  simp [step, h]

theorem req_reverse_succeeds : ReverseSucceeds step := sorry

theorem req_invalid_noop     : InvalidNoop step := sorry

theorem req_post_effects     : PostEffects step := sorry

theorem req_reverse_effects  : ReverseEffects step := sorry

theorem req_reverse_once     : ReverseOnce step := sorry

theorem req_roundtrip        : RoundTrip step := sorry

theorem postLines_eq (ls : List Line) (bal : AccountId → Int) (a : AccountId) :
    postLines ls bal a = bal a + netOf ls a := by
  induction ls generalizing bal with
  | nil => simp [postLines, netOf]
  | cons l ls ih =>
    simp [postLines, netOf, sumOver_cons]
    -- adjust then recurse
    -- need to show adjust bal l.1 l.2 a + ...? Actually postLines ls (adjust bal l.1 l.2) a
    -- = (if a = l.1 then bal a + l.2 else bal a) + netOf ls a
    -- = bal a + (if a = l.1 then l.2 else 0) + netOf ls a
    -- which equals bal a + netOf (l :: ls) a
    have h1 : postLines ls (adjust bal l.1 l.2) a = (adjust bal l.1 l.2) a + netOf ls a := ih (adjust bal l.1 l.2)
    rw [h1]
    simp [adjust]
    split_ifs with h
    · simp [h, netOf]
    · simp [h, netOf]

import Reversal.Spec
import Reversal.Lemmas
namespace Reversal

instance instDecidableValidPost (s : State) (e : Entry) : Decidable (ValidPost s e) := by
  unfold ValidPost; infer_instance

/-- Add `amt` to account `a`. -/
def adjust (bal : AccountId → Int) (a : AccountId) (amt : Int) : AccountId → Int :=
  fun b => if b = a then bal b + amt else bal b

/-- Post every line, first to last. -/
def postLines : List Line → (AccountId → Int) → (AccountId → Int)
  | [], bal => bal
  | l :: ls, bal => postLines ls (adjust bal l.1 l.2)

/-- Apply lines with negated amounts (used for reversal). -/
def reverseLines : List Line → (AccountId → Int) → (AccountId → Int)
  | [], bal => bal
  | l :: ls, bal => reverseLines ls (adjust bal l.1 (-l.2))

def step : Impl := fun s c =>
  match c with
  | .post e =>
    if ValidPost s e then
      (.ok, { s with balance := postLines e.lines s.balance, journal := s.journal ++ [e] })
    else (.rejected, s)
  | .reverse i =>
    match findEntry s.journal i with
    | some e =>
      if i ∈ s.reversed then (.rejected, s)
      else (.ok, { s with balance := reverseLines e.lines s.balance,
                          reversed := i :: s.reversed })
    | none => (.rejected, s)

theorem test_sum : (0 : Int) + 0 = 0 := rfl

theorem req_post_succeeds : PostSucceeds step := by
  unfold PostSucceeds
  intro s e h
  simp [step, h]

theorem req_reverse_succeeds : ReverseSucceeds step := sorry

theorem req_invalid_noop     : InvalidNoop step := sorry

theorem req_post_effects     : PostEffects step := sorry

theorem req_reverse_effects  : ReverseEffects step := sorry

theorem req_reverse_once     : ReverseOnce step := sorry

theorem req_roundtrip        : RoundTrip step := sorry

theorem req_trial_balance    : TrialBalance step := sorry

theorem req_well_formed      : StaysWellFormed step := sorry

theorem req_consistent       : StaysConsistent step := sorry

end Reversal

import Reversal.Spec
import Reversal.Lemmas
namespace Reversal

instance instDecidableValidPost (s : State) (e : Entry) : Decidable (ValidPost s e) := by
  unfold ValidPost; infer_instance

/-- Add `amt` to account `a`. -/
def adjust (bal : AccountId → Int) (a : AccountId) (amt : Int) : AccountId → Int :=
  fun b => if b = a then bal b + amt else bal b

/-- Post every line, first to last. -/
def postLines : List Line → (AccountId → Int) → (AccountId → Int)
  | [], bal => bal
  | l :: ls, bal => postLines ls (adjust bal l.1 l.2)

/-- Apply lines with negated amounts (used for reversal). -/
def reverseLines : List Line → (AccountId → Int) → (AccountId → Int)
  | [], bal => bal
  | l :: ls, bal => reverseLines ls (adjust bal l.1 (-l.2))

def step : Impl := fun s c =>
  match c with
  | .post e =>
    if ValidPost s e then
      (.ok, { s with balance := postLines e.lines s.balance, journal := s.journal ++ [e] })
    else (.rejected, s)
  | .reverse i =>
    match findEntry s.journal i with
    | some e =>
      if i ∈ s.reversed then (.rejected, s)
      else (.ok, { s with balance := reverseLines e.lines s.balance,
                          reversed := i :: s.reversed })
    | none => (.rejected, s)

theorem test_sum : (0 : Int) + 0 = 0 := rfl

theorem findEntry_mem (j : List Entry) (i : EntryId) (e : Entry) (h : findEntry j i = some e) : i ∈ j.map (·.id) := by
  induction j with
  | nil => cases h
  | cons e' es ih =>
    simp [findEntry] at h
    by_cases h_eq : e'.id = i
    · simp [h_eq] at h
      subst h
      simp [List.mem_cons, h_eq]
    · simp [h_eq] at h
      have hmem := ih h
      exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hmem

theorem netOf_cons (l : Line) (ls : List Line) (a : AccountId) :
    netOf (l :: ls) a = (if l.1 = a then l.2 else 0) + netOf ls a := by
  simp [netOf, sumOver_cons]

theorem req_post_succeeds : PostSucceeds step := by
  unfold PostSucceeds
  intro s e h
  simp [step, h]

theorem req_reverse_succeeds : ReverseSucceeds step := sorry

theorem req_invalid_noop     : InvalidNoop step := sorry

theorem req_post_effects     : PostEffects step := sorry

theorem req_reverse_effects  : ReverseEffects step := sorry

theorem req_reverse_once     : ReverseOnce step := sorry

theorem req_roundtrip        : RoundTrip step := sorry

theorem req_trial_balance    : TrialBalance step := sorry

theorem req_well_formed      : StaysWellFormed step := sorry

theorem req_consistent       : StaysConsistent step := sorry

end Reversal

def adjust (bal : AccountId → Int) (a : AccountId) (amt : Int) : AccountId → Int :=

  | [], bal => bal

  | .reverse i =>

import Reversal.Spec
import Reversal.Lemmas
namespace Reversal

instance instDecidableValidPost (s : State) (e : Entry) : Decidable (ValidPost s e) := by
  unfold ValidPost; infer_instance

/-- Add `amt` to account `a`. -/
def adjust (bal : AccountId → Int) (a : AccountId) (amt : Int) : AccountId → Int :=
  fun b => if b = a then bal b + amt else bal b

/-- Post every line, first to last. -/
def postLines : List Line → (AccountId → Int) → (AccountId → Int)
  | [], bal => bal
  | l :: ls, bal => postLines ls (adjust bal l.1 l.2)

/-- Apply lines with negated amounts (used for reversal). -/
def reverseLines : List Line → (AccountId → Int) → (AccountId → Int)
  | [], bal => bal
  | l :: ls, bal => reverseLines ls (adjust bal l.1 (-l.2))

def step : Impl := fun s c =>
  match c with
  | .post e =>
    if ValidPost s e then
      (.ok, { s with balance := postLines e.lines s.balance, journal := s.journal ++ [e] })
    else (.rejected, s)
  | .reverse i =>
    match findEntry s.journal i with
    | some e =>
      if i ∈ s.reversed then (.rejected, s)
      else (.ok, { s with balance := reverseLines e.lines s.balance,
                          reversed := i :: s.reversed })
    | none => (.rejected, s)

theorem test_sum : (0 : Int) + 0 = 0 := rfl

theorem findEntry_mem (j : List Entry) (i : EntryId) (e : Entry) (h : findEntry j i = some e) : i ∈ j.map (·.id) := by
  induction j with
  | nil => cases h
  | cons e' es ih =>
    simp [findEntry] at h
    by_cases h_eq : e'.id = i
    · simp [h_eq] at h
      subst h
      simp [List.mem_cons, h_eq]
    · simp [h_eq] at h
      have hmem := ih h
      exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hmem

theorem netOf_cons (l : Line) (ls : List Line) (a : AccountId) :
    netOf (l :: ls) a = (if l.1 = a then l.2 else 0) + netOf ls a := by
  simp [netOf, sumOver_cons]

theorem sum_nil (l : List AccountId) : sumOver l (fun _ : AccountId => 0) = 0 := by
  induction l with
  | nil => simp
  | cons a l ih => simp [sumOver_cons, ih]

theorem req_post_succeeds : PostSucceeds step := by
  unfold PostSucceeds
  intro s e h
  simp [step, h]

theorem req_reverse_succeeds : ReverseSucceeds step := sorry

theorem req_invalid_noop     : InvalidNoop step := sorry

theorem req_post_effects     : PostEffects step := sorry

theorem req_reverse_effects  : ReverseEffects step := sorry

theorem req_reverse_once     : ReverseOnce step := sorry

theorem req_roundtrip        : RoundTrip step := sorry

theorem req_trial_balance    : TrialBalance step := sorry

theorem req_well_formed      : StaysWellFormed step := sorry

theorem req_consistent       : StaysConsistent step := sorry

end Reversal
